verdict.rationale: Bitwarden gives users some control over their data. They can export the vault (docs-5) and self-host on their own Linux server (docs-10), which puts storage and retention under their control, and the CLI is described as a fully-featured vault-management tool (docs-7). Account deletion is implied only by a community anecdote (comm-2), and no first-party evidence documents deletion workflows or retention policies. Missing for 10: documented account/item deletion procedures, retention-period controls or policies, data-purge guarantees, and independent corroboration.
